verifications.claim: NASA's Artemis 2 mission successfully launched on Wednesday, April 1, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: '6:36 PM / April 1, 2026 Artemis II lifts off Artemis II lifted off at 6:35 p.m. EDT.'; R2: 'blasted off from Florida on Wednesday evening'; R8: 'The Space Launch System rocket and Orion spacecraft... lifted off from Kennedy Space Center in Florida at 6:35 p.m. ET.'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm successful launch on April 1, 2026, described as Wednesday.
